result.stdout:
Usage: whoholds [options] [<file-or-port>]

Find which processes are holding a file lock or binding a network port.

Options:
  --pid-only                   Force one-PID-per-line output (auto when piped)
  -l, --full-path              Show full executable path instead of process name
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Examples:
  whoholds myfile.dll                                         Find what's locking a file
  whoholds :8080                                              Find what's binding port 8080
  whoholds myfile.dll --pid-only | wargs taskkill /PID {} /F  Kill all processes locking a file

Composes with:
  whoholds myfile.dll --pid-only | wargs taskkill /PID {} /F  Kill all processes locking a file

Exit Codes:
  0    Success (includes no-results)
  1    Target not found or query error (file/directory does not exist, or backend API failure)
  125  Usage error (bad flags, missing positional, invalid port number, or unrecognised argument shape)
